description_en: Creates and confirms a record after a honeypot file is uploaded
description_zh: 蜜罐文件上传后，创建并确认记录
kebab_example: aliyun sas uploaded-honey-pot-file --file-key HONEYPOT_FILE/1601097845544644_00000000 --file-name trojan.zip --file-type application/zip --template-extra help_:_.zip_,_label_:_file_,_type_:_file_,_key_:_ftpfiles.zip --honeypot-image-name ruoyi --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UploadedHoneyPotFile

parameters.help_en:
The FileKey used to upload the file.
Format: HONEYPOT_FILE/{timestamp}_{custom_file_name}
parameters.help_zh:
上传文件使用的FileKey。
格式为：HONEYPOT_FILE/{时间戳}_{自定义文件名}
parameters.name: file_key

parameters.help_en: The name of the uploaded file
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the honeypot management node.
Call the [ListHoneypotNode](~~ListHoneypotNode~~) operation to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh:
蜜罐管理节点ID。
调用[ListHoneypotNode](~~ListHoneypotNode~~)接口获取该值
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The template prompt corresponding to the uploaded file
parameters.help_zh: 上传文件对应的模板提示
parameters.name: template_extra

parameters.help_en: The name of the honeypot image
parameters.name: honeypot_image_name

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of the failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码。200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Message.description_en: The message returned for the request

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
